caveats:
The ‘//Karas’ administrative level 1 feature name includes the click consonant that is symbolized with a non-Latin character. The ADM1_EN attribute field includes only Roman characters but the ADM1ALT1EN field includes the click consonant symbol.

This dataset fits the former 107 constituency system but does reflect the split of Kavango region into Kavango East and West, and Caprivi to Zambezi name change.  Namibia has adopted a new 121 constituency system .

notes:
Namibia administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 14 Region  
- Admin 2: 107 Constituency  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 28 January 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 09 January 2020: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 01 January 2011: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 January 2011: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).
